en: A philatelic postcard with a minimalist blue-and-red line drawing of an alpine skier in the lower left corner on a white background. In the upper right corner there is a blue postage stamp featuring a stylized skier and Olympic rings with the text "Lillehammer '94" and denomination "1,25s KR". The stamp is cancelled with a circular postmark that includes text around the edge and a small skiing figure.
